title: Bounded orbital transfer search
summary: Bounded validated circular/elliptical same-body and interbody transfer intent.

blocks.text: flight.transfers@1.0.0 requires flight.plans@1.0.0. The platform host binds its selected flight.maneuver-burn@1.0.0 through withBurns; presentation providers do not acquire platform/clock access. With compatible finite plan services it accepts generic shared-ancestor relationships, compares direct and staged paths, and publishes only complete finite-validated routes. Hierarchy-derived paths consider destination staging, source staging and both; no mandatory capture into a common ancestor. At most seven legs (14 nodes), two safe parking-radius proposals per stop and a beam retaining two cheapest and two earliest prefixes. Each leg is bounded at8,000,000 cooperative steps; after a success it samples two more windows or stops after two accepted candidates. Each leg uses at most24 shortlisted Lambert/ejection corrections,18 differential-correction iterations and up to eight damping retries for finite probes; every accepted capture refines actual finite thrust and validates a safe revolution. Final complete sequences are reevaluated before publication. Explicit maxFlightSeconds includes waiting and every leg; default50 and maximum100 Julian years. Default display forecasts retain their shorter bound. Route metadata supplies body IDs, stops, horizon, finiteValidated and per-node burn costs/durations. Efficient and Faster compare complete mission costs; bounded beam sampling is not global optimization. Without a burn provider, legacy same-body and direct parent/child/sibling impulsive planning remains available and other relationships return an explanation. Cancellation closes all child jobs and contexts. Search never steps authority, commands thrust, arms execution or changes a view. TransferProgress.options may publish only validated complete options; callers invalidate them on source or committed-input changes. First-tick and last-tick fractional thrust keep the finite controller continuous across 10ms timing boundaries. Target apsis tolerance is max(.01m,radius*1e-7); encounter/contact and work limits can reject all proposals. Route searches interleave cooperatively; identical pending legs share their completed cache. TransferProgress.phase identifies current work; the optional fraction is a nondecreasing whole-search estimate in [0, 1] (tested/total may describe one leg only), and hosts show indeterminate progress without it. TransferResult.compared counts fully validated direct/staged alternatives even when dominated by the displayed options. Older plan providers without withBurns and finite evaluation retain legacy relationship coverage.
